motivation: EPRO_DEV_05 (deep mechanistic EPRO backbone + changer head) failed to converge (val study-macro AUPRC plateau ~0.52, persistent train/val gap ~0.16), far below the flat MLP changer classifier (EPRO_DEV_04, AUPRC 0.7344). The failure is architectural, not capacity-driven: the deep backbone neither fits nor generalizes while the simple per-position classifier already ranks changers well. DEV_06 therefore keeps the proven flat classifier and injects explicit structure-aware (base-pair contact-graph) features that the 36-dim B0-X+delta_thermo vector omits, then aligns the horizontal comparison to published ViennaRNA Turner-rules physics and the internal P2/wt baselines on the same changer-detection task.
hypothesis: A flat per-position changer classifier augmented with explicit structure-aware base-pair contact-graph features (per-position pairing probability, structural partner aggregation of WT reactivity and of mutant-WT structural deltas, local structural context windows) achieves a study-macro AUPRC gain over the plain 36-dim classifier (EPRO_DEV_04) whose cluster-CI lower bound is > 0, and does not underperform the published ViennaRNA Turner-rules physics baseline on the same estimated changer-detection task.

arms.added_features: contact-graph pairing & partner-aggregation & local structural windows

selection_rule.primary_metric: study-macro AUPRC gain over strongest validated changer classifier (EPRO_DEV_04)

evaluation.estimand_b: signed magnitude (Student-t, >=5% relative improvement to keep headline)

stop_conditions: 3 consecutive rounds without beating strongest validated changer classifier
